node.title: SOV forced-root obstruction correctness
node.statement: The generalized forced square-root recursion correctly produces the obstruction vector for every h in the intended band, and every active h-core forces the relevant obstruction coordinates to vanish.
node.attack_surface: assembly from the proved forced-root recursion algebra and the remaining active-core obstruction-vanishing theorem
node.falsifier: an active core in the intended h band whose forced-root obstruction vector does not vanish, or a mismatch with the banked h=5/X79 construction
